grh_2546acbd1aad78eae0fa.title: Revolt
paragraphs: Nineteen-year-old Bill and Helen arrive in Rivers End posing as brother and sister after running away from Minneapolis. Resentful of what he calls a system that keeps young people powerless, Bill plans to rob Dr. Christian's safe and pressures Helen to learn the combination, eventually threatening the doctor with a gun. Dr. Christian has already recognized their lies, found the police bulletin and quietly removed the cartridges from Bill's weapon. Confronted with how completely his rebellion has turned into crime, Bill abandons the robbery and decides to return voluntarily, face the consequences and then work honestly toward a future. Helen's mother is coming to take her home, and the two young people leave their marriage plans for a more responsible time.
